title: Plant Memory: Technical Language Processing and a Verified Maintenance Ontology for Agent-Accessible Failure Knowledge from SAP PM Work Orders
abstract: arXiv:2610.19131v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Maintenance work orders are the largest written record of how industrial equipment fails, yet in most plants they are close to unusable for analysis. Short texts are abbreviated and misspelt, asset identity is buried in free text, work-type labels contradict the work described, and the fields that matter most for reliability (symptom, root cause, action taken) are usually empty. As a result, diagnostic knowledge stays with senior technicians and leaves when they do. We present Plant Memory, a system that applies technical language processing (TLP) to SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) exports and builds an ISO 14224-aligned maintenance ontology in which every extracted statement is a reified fact carrying a confidence score, the evidence it was read from, and a verification state. translated_title: Plant Memory（工厂记忆）：基于技术语言处理与经核验的维护本体，将SAP PM工单转化为智能体可访问的故障知识
translated_abstract: 维护工单是记录工业设备如何失效的最庞大书面资料，但在大多数工厂中，这些工单几乎无法用于分析。文本简短且充满缩写和拼写错误，资产标识被埋没在自由文本中，工作类型标签与所描述的工作相互矛盾，而对可靠性最为重要的字段（症状、根本原因、所采取的措施）通常是空白的。其结果是，诊断知识只留存于资深技术人员的手中，并随他们的离职而流失。我们提出了Plant Memory，这是一个将技术语言处理（TLP）应用于SAP工厂维护（PM）导出数据的系统，它构建了一个符合ISO 14224标准的维护本体，其中每一条被提取的语句都是一个具体化的事实，附带置信度分数、其读取来源的证据以及核验状态。提取以规则优先，可选的大语言模型（LLM）充当“第二读者”，其与规则的分歧会提升相应事实的复核优先级，而不是直接覆盖……
tldr: 提出了Plant Memory系统，通过规则优先、LLM辅助的技术语言处理，将难以分析的SAP PM维护工单转化为符合ISO 14224标准、每条事实均带置信度、证据溯源与核验状态的维护本体，使设备故障知识可被智能体访问，避免诊断知识随资深技师流失。
en_tdlr: Plant Memory applies rule-first technical language processing with optional LLM verification to SAP PM work orders, building an ISO 14224-aligned maintenance ontology where every fact carries confidence, evidence, and verification state, making plant failure knowledge agent-accessible.
